- **Title**: “Does 12‑Week Aerobics Training Influence Body Composition in Middle‑Aged Women?”

- **Genome sequencing**: >90 genotypes, 28,000 genes, several million markers.  
- **Food uses**: human consumption (hummus, salads, stews, fried forms), animal feed (protein‑rich, safer than similar legumes).  
- **Nutritional content**: >20 % Daily Value protein, dietary fiber, folate, iron, phosphorus, moderate zinc, thiamin, vitamin B6, magnesium.
